'''Aghan''' is a [[Saldaean]] under the command of [[Davram Bashere]]. 

== Appearance ==
He has a thick mustache.

== Activities ==
He is one of the Saldaeans to accompany Bashere and [[Rand al'Thor]] to Rand's meeting with the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]]. During this meeting it is revealed that the supposed Daughter of the Nine Moons is actually [[Semirhage]] in disguise. After a fight insues, he is asked to secure the area by Bashere.
